title: E-Math trigonometry: ratios and the sine rule
subject: math

objectives.text: Name the opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse for an angle in a right-angled triangle
successCriteria: I can name the side across from angle theta as the opposite, the side next to theta as the adjacent, and the longest side as the hypotenuse
I can say the labels belong to the angle I am working with, so they move when the angle moves
assessmentPoints: Side-naming answers in the opening activity
Partner explanations of which side is which

objectives.text: Use SOH CAH TOA to find sine, cosine and tangent ratios
successCriteria: I can read the card as SOH CAH TOA: sine opposite hypotenuse, cosine adjacent hypotenuse, tangent opposite adjacent
I can state sin theta = 3/5 = 0.6, cos theta = 4/5 = 0.8 and tan theta = 3/4 = 0.75 for the 3-4-5 triangle
assessmentPoints: Ratio answers in the second activity
Worksheet answers checked against the trap in the fourth activity

objectives.text: Use the sine rule to find an unknown side in any triangle
successCriteria: I can pair each side with the sine of its opposite angle: a / sin A = b / sin B
I can find side b as about 6.93 from a = 4, A = 30 degrees and B = 60 degrees, and check the larger angle sits opposite the longer side
assessmentPoints: Sine-rule pairing answers in the third activity
Sine-rule answers in the closing worksheet practice

activities.title: Meet the 3-4-5 triangle and name the sides
Cosine and tangent join the SOH CAH TOA card
The sine rule for a triangle with no right angle

differentiation.support: Provide the student notes worked example open at the pairing step so learners can follow a = 4 with A = 30 degrees before rearranging for b themselves.

activities.title: A common mistake: the flipped tangent

differentiation.stretch: Ask learners to explain why a tangent of 4/3 = 1.33 must be wrong for this triangle before checking the card.
